sec11-R25.text: Drive slower with a trailer because its smaller wheels spin faster and can overheat the wheel bearings, and because your car brakes were probably not built for heavy trailer loads, so a hard stop at high speed could overturn both vehicles.

sec11-R26.text: Load limits differ by direction: three feet ahead of the front, a flag once the overhang behind reaches four feet, none past the left fender line, and up to six inches past the right fender line.
